mw_chain_axe.on_crit: Your target becomes Shredded until the end of the current turn.
mw_bristlecrown_flechette_launcher.effec: This weapon ignores ranged penalties from Engaged, and deals 3 Kinetic damage to Grappled or Biological targets, instead of 1.
mw_assault_cannon.profiles.0.name: Standard
mw_assault_cannon.profiles.0.effect: You can spin up this weapon’s barrels as a quick action.
mw_assault_cannon.profiles.0.actions.0.d: Spin up the barrels of the Assault Cannon, Slowing your mech and allowing use of its "Spin-Up Mode" profile.
mw_assault_cannon.profiles.1.name: Spin-Up Mode
mw_assault_cannon.profiles.1.effect:
While spinning, this weapon gains Reliable 3, but you become Slowed.
You can end this effect as a protocol.
mw_assault_cannon.profiles.1.actions.0.d: End the Assault Cannon's "Spin-Up Mode", ending the Slowed condition and allowing the Assault Cannon to be used with its "Standard" profile.
mw_concussion_missiles.on_hit.detail: The target must succeed on a Hull save or become Impaired until the end of their next turn.
mw_leviathan_heavy_assault_cannon.profil: Unlike other Superheavy weapons, the Leviathan can be used with Skirmish. You can spin up this weapon’s barrels as a quick action.
Spin up the barrels of the Leviathan Heavy Assault Cannon, Slowing your mech and allowing use of its "Spin-Up Mode" profile.

While spinning, you are Slowed and can no longer use the Leviathan with Skirmish.
You can cease this effect as a protocol.
End the Leviathan Heavy Assault Cannon's "Spin-Up Mode", ending the Slowed condition and allowing the Leviathan to be used with its "Standard" profile.
mw_cutter_mkii_plasma_torch.effect: This weapon deals 10AP energy to objects, cover, terrain, and the environment.
mw_power_knuckles.on_crit.detail: Your target must succeed on a Hull save or be knocked Prone.
mw_daisy_cutter.on_attack: Creates a cloud of smoke and detritus in the attack cone, providing soft cover in the affected area that lasts until the end of your next turn.
mw_catalytic_hammer.on_crit.detail: Your target must succeed on a Hull save or become Stunned until the end of their next turn.
mw_impact_lance.on_attack: You also attack all characters in a Line between you and your target. You take 1 heat for each target past the first.
mw_impaler_nailgun.on_hit.detail: Targets must succeed on a Hull save or become Immobilized until the end of their next turn.
mw_combat_drill.effect: When attacking a character that is Prone, Immobilized, or Stunned, this weapon’s Overkill tag does an extra +1d6 bonus damage each time it activates. This can activate indefinitely if the new bonus die result is a 1, triggering Overkill again.
mw_magnetic_cannon.on_hit.detail: All characters within the affected area must succeed on a Hull save or be pulled 1d3+1 spaces toward you, or as close as possible.
mw_veil_rifle.effect: This weapon does not attack allied characters caught in its area of effect; instead, it shrouds them in a field of coruscating energy that throws off targeting systems, giving them soft cover until the end of their next turn.
